## VaultKeeper.authorize() method

Decrypt and validate a JWE token.

The returned `claims` never contain the raw secret value. Read the secret through the one-time [SecretAccessor](./wasm.secretaccessor.md) on `result.secret`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
authorize(jwe: string): AuthorizeResult;
```
